description:
Run the FREE precheck for listing a coin on Coin Duel (no payment needed). Live on-chain data:
pool liquidity, pool age, holders, top-10 concentration, honeypot sell test, mint authority.
Returns pass/fail per check plus the exact sign_message for the paid submit step. Chains: base,
ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, solana. Only submit (and pay 100 USDC) when every check passes.
name: coinduel_listing_precheck
